<h2>Test Prepared Fold Content Against Current Preparation Code</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reconstructs folds in memory and requires exact analytical equality. This
permits error-only code changes without rewriting operational runtimes in
cached folds or invalidating successful fitting descendants.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>is_sjsdm_cv_prepared_folds_current(
  store_path,
  target_name,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw,
  prepare_fold_function = prepare_sjsdm_cross_validation_fold,
  load_metadata_function = targets::tar_meta
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="store_path">store_path</code>, <code id="target_name">target_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Existing store and one prepared-fold endpoint.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code>, <code id="prepare_fold_function">prepare_fold_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable cached target reader and current fold-preparation adapter.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="load_metadata_function">load_metadata_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target metadata reader for current input-name resolution.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Call only after every upstream input and configuration has been verified.
This function does not execute targets, fit models, or write to stores.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A logical scalar; unreadable inputs and reconstruction errors fail.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
is_sjsdm_cv_prepared_folds_current(store, "list_sjsdm_prepared_tuning_folds")

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
